mapper.select: SELECT oi.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec, m.unit FROM ecom_order_item oi LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = oi.material_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id
